alt.en: BERT predicts red from all three corrupted slots. GPT predicts red from BOS only. T5 predicts red from two source slots and decoder prefix BOS,S0, with separate encoder, decoder and cross-attention matrices.
alt.zh-hans: BERT 从三个替换后槽位预测 red；GPT 只从 BOS 预测 red；T5 使用两个源槽位和解码前缀 BOS、S0 预测 red，编码、自注意力和交叉注意力分别计算。
